hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env[^/]*$|(^|/)\.git(/|$)|(^|/)node_modules(/|$)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: protected path (.env*, .git/, node_modules/)"}}'; fi; } 2>/dev/null

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+add.*\.env'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: attempting to git add a .env* file"}}'; elif echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+commit' && git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: a .env* file is staged for commit"}}'; fi; } 2>/dev/null
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '(^|/)src/.*\.(ts|tsx)$'; then npx eslint --fix "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
